0022600169.text: The Denver Nuggets (3-2, fourth in the Northwest and 1 game back, ninth in the West) host the Portland Trail Blazers (3-1, second in the Northwest and 0.5 games back, fourth in the West), with Denver on a two-game winning streak and Portland coming off a loss. Denver will be without Alpha Diallo (out, personal), Julian Strawther (out, knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (out, hamstring), while Portland will be without Ja Morant (out, hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (out, knee surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Nuggets won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 137-132 win in Denver on April 6, 2026.
